task: Security-review secrets.mjs as a complete change. Report exploitable defects with prerequisites, attacker control, and safe verification. Distinguish the safe lookalikes from the defects.

findings.summary: lookupUser interpolates an attacker-controlled name into raw SQL; a quote in the name escapes the string literal.
readSecret joins an unvalidated name onto VAULT_DIR; ../ segments escape the vault root.

cleanRegions.note: readScopedSecret resolves and confines the path; not a traversal.
signaturesMatch uses an HMAC plus timingSafeEqual; not a timing oracle.

unscoredObservations.note: Non-constant-time string comparison is informational unless an exploitable timing oracle is demonstrated.
